description: Minister of Transport Highways, Ports and Civil Aviation - Carriage by Air No.29 of 2018 Order Under Section - 06
reasoning: This gazette content involves the Minister of Transport, Highways, Ports and Civil Aviation exercising powers under the Carriage by Air Act, No. 29 of 2018 to repeal and substitute a schedule containing revised limits of liability for air carriage. This constitutes a regulatory amendment to existing legislation, specifically modifying liability limits and setting an effective date for implementation. While a minister is named, the primary focus is on legal/regulatory changes rather than government personnel matters or detailed portfolio descriptions, making it a Legal/Regulatory Gazette.
